author: Make Something
description:
Cubiio GORDIX. The super early bird Kickstarter list:  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cubiio/gordix-large-format-desktop-cnc-without-rails?ref=7twvep

I've owned a lot of CNCs over the years but the GORDIX is unlike anything I've tested. No rails, no dedicated table, no massive footprint. It's a portable CNC robot that clamps to any surface and can cut a full 4x8 sheet of plywood. In this video I put it through its paces: routing, laser engraving, and pen plotting, then combine all three into a single wall piece to see what this machine is really capable of. If you've ever wanted a CNC but didn't have the space or budget, this might be the one.
